records.title: Child time expiry retains stream
records.inherited_static_observation: Client follows keep-stream termination and host enforces game process, not the stream.
records.repair_contract: Terminal child expiry must disconnect the bound stream without affecting a newer parent session.

records.title: Child full quit uses parent-style Gateway snapshot
records.inherited_static_observation: The overload defaults childSession=false and snapshot reads health forbidden to a child.
records.repair_contract: Propagate actor/execution context; do not expand child endpoint permission to hide a caller bug.

records.title: Full quit waits for host before local disconnect
records.inherited_static_observation: Host verification/polling precedes local stop, and failure can retain the stream.
records.repair_contract: Separate unconditional local stop from asynchronous fenced host cleanup and honest status.

records.title: Release default disables background retention
records.inherited_static_observation: Inherited audit reports default debug=5 minutes and release=0.
records.repair_contract: Unify absent-setting policy, preserve explicit choices and validate fresh release as well as debug.

records.title: Game Activity owns live transport
records.inherited_static_observation: Destroying the resource owner can stop a logically retained connection.
records.repair_contract: Move physical lifetime behind a stable existing facade; distinguish Activity recreation from process death.

records.title: Game identity mismatch invalidates transport projection
records.inherited_static_observation: retainedLive depends on gameId agreement, and multiple projections can turn unknown game into idle host.
records.repair_contract: Independent axes and one derived projection for badge, tile and launch decisions.

records.title: Preflight waits for streamer before enabling login
records.inherited_static_observation: Streamer readiness can gate the Windows sign-in that starts per-profile components.
records.repair_contract: Gateway availability, authorized Windows session and streamer readiness need ordered separate stages.

records.title: Missing or timed-out sign-in can look ready
records.inherited_static_observation: null represents continue but is also returned for some unknown states and expired waiting.
records.repair_contract: Typed outcomes; only positive correct-identity READY permits automatic continuation.

records.title: Stop callbacks can precede actual native stop
records.inherited_static_observation: Flags clear before background stop; later callers or upper completion can finish early.
records.repair_contract: Shared actual stop result per generation, tested with a deliberately blocked stop.

records.title: Readiness combines different host moments
records.inherited_static_observation: Separate health/current/readiness responses lack a shared host revision.
records.repair_contract: Coherent atomically versioned observation and epoch fencing, not only local transition IDs.

records.title: Cover callback can be lost with view detachment
records.inherited_static_observation: Two postOnAnimation callbacks do not prove frame submission; detachment can drop continuation.
records.repair_contract: Explicit frame barrier outcomes, canonical reveal gate and terminal cleanup independent of drawing.
